title: Harvesting Hydrostatic Pressure Fluctuations Dynamically via Multi-Level Chambers
content: The device is WEC which operates by synchronizing wave induced volume changes by hydrostatic pressure fluctuations on vertical multi-level chambers and harness their oscillations dynamically as per each wave characteristics via single PTO unitThis novel apparatus introduces wave energy converter device by utilizing the hydrostatic pressure fluctuations on many air-filled cylindrical reservoirs stacked vertically over each other under sea surface with piston at the bottom of each one, and all pistons will be sharing single central shaft firmly fixed to all of them, these cylinders are firmly fixed in altitude on vertically erected structure on the seabed.The many small cylinders solution is way more sensitive to small changes in pressure and can convert more hydrostatic pressure changes into energy from the incident wave, while one big cylinder with equal volume to all smaller ones might not be effective at all practically due to non-efficient compressibility of the gas in one big volume cylinder during the limited time frame of the wave.In order to achieve the exact distance oscillation for all pistons, we can either quantitatively reduce the volumes of the cylinders from bottom to top or reduce the area of the pistons from top to bottom by precise formula for each solution.Since cost-effective scalability is the first main challenge facing this method of energy harnessing, this apparatus was designed mainly to address this first challenge, these cylinders will be configured to do precise different works on gas - in case of volume quantitative reduction solution- to cause the same volume oscillation as per each one’s depth, and hence do the same work on each piston by making the exact piston’s displacement in each cylinder as per the incident wave crest and trough, or - in case of piston area reduction solution - the bigger forces applied on each piston of the top cylinders will be distributed over bigger area’s pistons to reduce the displacement, in this case we will end up with different forces and same displacement, as result for this unified oscillation amplitude, the connected central shaft will oscillate as per the exact piston’s displacements and consolidate their total work output to harness the combined work done by all pistons as unified force with unified displacement.Since each wave has different characteristics and requires different settings for maximum energy harnessing, this is the second main challenge the device was designed to address, the system will change specific settings automatically for each wave as per the fed data to the logarithms and will be dynamically responsive system as per each wave characteristics, later on we will provide many solutions for the dynamic responsiveness.And since harvesting hydrostatic pressure changes isn’t efficient process in the first place compared to other WECs relying on both the dynamic pressure and potential energy, the system was designed to address this third main challenge and increase the wave height on the expense of the kinetic energy which renders this invention as more viable solution, since the potential energy of the wave will quadruple when the wave height is doubled, this amplification will significantly increase the efficiency of this device, later on we explore many options to amplify the wave and enhance the shoaling effect to drive up the efficiency of the system further more.Since the wave height has exponential relation to energy, so this device efficiency significantly increases as the wave height increases, and in some cases it can be more cost effective than all the other renewables.
